title: Newhalo press kit
description: A press-kit section on paper: a sticky left column with a 64px heading and white download cards (24px name, small caption, orange 'download' bar with an icon square), and on the right a stack of wide dark pictures with 8px corners, each with a small orange download tile in its corner. Pictures bloom in (fade + 1.1→1) as they scroll into view.
notes: the left column sticks below the header while the pictures scroll past (desktop)
